description: Put a document in a Space so everyone in it can open it. Editors and the owner can change it; viewers read it. Name an existing spaceId, or newSpaceName to make one. Only the document owner may do this, and only into a Space where they are owner or editor. A document is in one Space at most, so this moves it.

documentId.description: The document id, from tools_list_documents. Any builder's document.

newSpaceName.description: Make a Space with this name instead.

name: spaces_share_document
title: Put a document in a Space
